dunno. work stuff i guess. its probably nothing
Work stuff sounds like it’s sitting there anyway, even if it feels like “probably nothing.” Is it more vague, or more like you’d rather not look at it yet?
rather not look at it honestly. theres these layoffs coming. nobody will say who. my managers been weird w me all week
That sounds like a tense kind of not-knowing, with your manager’s weirdness making it feel even harder to stand in. Does it feel more like pressure, worry, or both?
worry. like a low hum i cant turn off. i keep refreshing my email waiting for the meeting invite that means im done. been here 6 yrs
That sounds like a low, constant worry — and the refreshing feels like you’re bracing for that invite. What does it make you want to do, if anything?
honestly part of me just wants them to do it already so the waiting stops. and part of me is terrified bc i dont know how id pay rent. i havent told anyone, not even my partner

That sounds split between wanting the waiting to end and being scared of what comes next, especially with rent and carrying it alone. If you want, we can stay with it here or look a little more at what the “not telling anyone” part is holding.
i think thats enough for now. i dont really wanna get into the partner thing. but it helped to say it out loud i guess. thanks
That’s enough for now, and that’s completely okay. I’m glad saying it out loud helped a little.
